title: Energy-Flow Cosmology, Part 2: Field Equations and Observable Mapping
author: Morten Magnusson
type: foundational white paper, field equations, observable mapping
abstract: Derives the EFC field equations from first principles, defines the entropy field S(a) and its coupling to the effective gravitational parameters mu(k,z) and Sigma(k,z), and establishes the complete observable mapping to growth rate f*sigma_8, weak-lensing amplitude S_8, and the regime response surface R(k,S).

entropy_field.definition: S(a) is a dimensionless scalar field tracking the mean entropy content of structure at cosmic epoch a

coupling_formula.note: beta is derived, not a free parameter

field_equation.meaning: Einstein tensor modulated by entropy gradient and energy-flow density

growth_equation.eq6: f'' + f^2 + (1/2 - 3/2 * Omega_m_tilde) * f = 3/2 * mu(a) * Omega_m_tilde
growth_equation.mu_effect: mu < 1 suppresses structure formation, generating S_8 tension reduction

S_8_suppression.eq10: Delta_sigma_8 proportional to (1 - mu_0) * integral g(a;n) d ln a
S_8_suppression.eq11: S_8 = sigma_8 * sqrt(Omega_m/0.3) ~ S_{8,LCDM} - delta_S_8(mu_0, B, n)
S_8_suppression.empirical: DES Y6 S_8 at 0.3 sigma (pre-registered, T2 tier)

lensing_slip.structural: Pure mu < 1 excluded; gravitational slip eta = Psi/Phi != 1 required
lensing_slip.testable: Directly testable with Stage-IV lensing surveys

response_surface.meaning: Unifies all perturbation-sector observables into single geometric object
response_surface.multi_probe: Each dataset provides empirical slice through R(k,S)

background_parameterisation.note: EFC operates in perturbation sector only (see Part 1, Remark 1)

signal_summary.characterisation: Persistent directional signal, not a detection
